title: Claude Code MCP Tool Description Cap (2KB) — v2.1.84
description: Claude Code v2.1.84 automatically caps MCP tool descriptions and server-level instruction text at 2KB per tool/server. Prevents OpenAPI-generated MCP servers from bloating context with verbose auto-generated documentation (parameter schemas, response examples, exhaustive parameter descriptions). No configuration required — enforced at the protocol layer after tool loading/selection. Orthogonal to Tool Search Tool (deferred loading) and disabledMcpjsonServers (full exclusion).
